summary: Held the entire window. After entry the trade moved favorably almost immediately (px +16 by t=1m) and built a strong, mostly monotonic run to a peak of about +234pts around t=16-17m, then oscillated/retraced in the +145 to +200 range through t=27m without ever threatening to erase gains or approach entry. Pullbacks (giveback spikes to ~15-38% off local peaks, and clusters of KMDR/HA/PROPP against-fires around t=18-22m) looked like normal profit-taking retracement within a still-deeply-favorable trade, not a genuine wrong-direction reversal, so I never saw a signature (price crossing back toward/through entry, or a sustained new-leg move against us) that justified bailing. Next time I'd watch for giveback approaching ~50-70% off peak combined with a NEW leg (age reset) whose amplitude is itself unfavorable, plus 3+ consecutive against-fires across multiple detectors sustained over consecutive frames -- that combination didn't occur here.
